decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith (1543/1C & 1543/2BA received 13 September 2012) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - The side facing windows shown as obscure glazed shown on drawing numbers 1543/1C & 1543/2B received 13 September 2012 shall permanently fixed shut and obscure glazed

Condition : 5 - The parking, loading and turning spaces shown on drawing No. 1543/1C  received 13 September 2012 shall be constructed and available for use before first occupation of any part of the development and such spaces shall not be used for any other purposes.
description: Erection of a two-storey extension to the rear of the property with addition of two new parking bays to the front
